scope: Eliminate the proven nested monitoring-policy checkout on an already bound classroom request, without weakening fresh school authority.

source.state: incremental shared worktree; source/test slice final
source.note: Archive-time hashes describe final files; red test predates product correction. Combined clean-source checks and workload acceptance remain separate.

finding.before: commands.ts binds a response-lifetime tenant connection, then requireClasspilotFullMonitoring acquired another. The combined03 first lock-screen request held its outer lease for5020ms and failed while the pool was saturated.
finding.after: A private WeakMap identifies the exact fresh ALS store that still owns a physical client. Ownership is removed before RESET begins, and matching non-super school context may perform the same bypassCache authority read on its own lease. Different school, super, unbound, released, releasing and stale reborrowed contexts take a fresh non-super lease.

coverage: Warm heartbeat settings cache cannot hide a changed monitoring policy
Different-school isolation and restored outer context
Same-school super context downscopes on a separate lease
No stale ALS reuse after same physical client is acquired by a fresh context
Existing tenant disconnect/reset/discard and report cancellation regressions
limitations: Pool/queries are instrumented in-process fakes using actual pg.Client, Drizzle, storage, middleware and policy logic; this slice adds no native database run.
No result or authority cache; no generic tenant helper reuse and no guarded Usage report ownership registration.
Does not establish100requests/sec acceptance or repair separate worker/WAL/CPU pressure.
No optional private-chat transaction consolidation was implemented.
sanitation: Home paths, database URLs and JWT-shaped values are redacted. All synthetic failure logs retained.
